subject: [stan-math] documentations for the function list in the paper appendix?

messages.author: 40b63348dbcb447d
messages.subject: [stan-math] documentations for the function list in the paper appendix?
parts:
There is a long list of function names at the end of http://arxiv.org/pdf/1509.07164.pdf. Is the documentation ready somewhere? Not all of them (say, elt_divide, though I guess it is for elementwise division) are included in the Stan reference. Thanks.

Best regards,
Ziyuan

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: [stan-math] documentations for the function list in the paper appendix?
parts:
On Thursday, August 11, 2016 at 11:53:19 AM UTC-4, ZiYuan Lin wrote:

There is a long list of function names at the end of http://arxiv.org/pdf/1509.07164.pdf. Is the documentation ready somewhere? Not all of them (say, elt_divide, though I guess it is for elementwise division) are included in the Stan reference. Thanks.

The Stan reference manual documents what a user would specify in the Stan language. In this case, it is documented as ".*" in the manual and the ".*" operator parses to the elt_divide C++ function. In other words, the user would not call elt_divide directly. The same goes for "./", etc.

Ben

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: [stan-math] documentations for the function list in the paper appendix?
parts:
In each tagged version, we generate and include the doxygen doc. It's not complete for every function, but it's a start. 

The master branch will always point to the current tagged release. See index.html within this folder:
https://github.com/stan-dev/math/tree/master/doc/api/html


Daniel
